game.name: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed
game.desc: Experimental ARM64 static-recompilation port of Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (2000, v3.2) for Anbernic H700 handhelds. Supply your own game files as a folder, ZIP or CD image; the native launcher unpacks/verifies/imports them and provides a settings UI. OpenGL ES renderer, SDL2 input/audio. Desktop is drivable; handheld performance is not yet qualified.
game.developer: EA Canada / EA Seattle; NFS5 static port contributors
